title: There is / There are — Word Order

questions.prompt: the living room / a sofa / There's / in
questions.answer: There's a sofa in the living room.

questions.prompt: There's / the bathroom / in / a mirror
questions.answer: There's a mirror in the bathroom.

questions.prompt: a lamp / on / the table / There's
questions.answer: There's a lamp on the table.

questions.prompt: There's / the shelf / on / a book
questions.answer: There's a book on the shelf.

questions.prompt: a rug / the bed / There's / under
questions.answer: There's a rug under the bed.

questions.prompt: on / the wall / There's / a clock
questions.answer: There's a clock on the wall.

questions.prompt: There's / in / the kitchen / a fridge
questions.answer: There's a fridge in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: the desk / next to / There's / a chair
questions.answer: There's a chair next to the desk.

questions.prompt: behind / a garden / the house / There's
questions.answer: There's a garden behind the house.

questions.prompt: There's / above / the sofa / a picture
questions.answer: There's a picture above the sofa.

questions.prompt: in / a TV / my bedroom / There is
questions.answer: There is a TV in my bedroom.

questions.prompt: There is / a window / the hall / in
questions.answer: There is a window in the hall.

questions.prompt: the kitchen / in / There is / a small table
questions.answer: There is a small table in the kitchen.
